list.title: Notifications
list.description: Everything the site has told you about your account, your tickets and what you bought. They are kept until you delete them.
list.delete_body: “{{title}}” will be removed from your notifications. This cannot be undone.
list.empty_unread: Nothing unread. You're all caught up.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: How we reach you outside this site. Changes are saved as you make them.

frequency.immediate_hint: One email per notification, as soon as it arrives.
frequency.daily_hint: One email a day at 09:00 Chile time, only if there is something new.
frequency.weekly_hint: One email every Monday at 09:00 Chile time, only if there is something new.
frequency.never_hint: No notification emails. You will still see everything here and, if enabled, as a push.

preferences.in_site_note: Notifications always appear on this site; these switches only decide what also reaches your devices and your inbox.
preferences.always_sent_note: Some emails are always sent, whatever you choose here, because they are the thing you asked for or a record you need: sign-in links, invitations, purchase receipts, refund notices and replies to your support tickets.
preferences.failed: Your preferences could not be loaded.

push.title: Push on your devices
push.description: Get a notification on this device even when the site is closed. Each browser or installed app is registered separately.
push.enabled: Push is on for this device.
push.enabled_toast: Push notifications enabled on this device.
push.disabled_toast: Push notifications turned off on this device.
push.test_none: No device received the test. Enable push on a device first.
push.devices_empty: No device is registered for push yet.
push.unsupported_title: This browser cannot receive push notifications
push.unsupported: Try a recent version of Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. You will still see every notification here.
push.ios_title: Add this site to your home screen first
push.ios_install: On iPhone and iPad, push notifications only work once the site is installed. Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”, open the site from the new icon and come back to this tab.
push.denied_title: Notifications are blocked for this site
push.denied: Your browser is set to refuse them. Allow notifications for franciscosolis.cl in the browser's site settings, then reload this page.
push.dismissed: The permission prompt was closed without an answer. Try again whenever you like.
push.failed: This device could not be registered. Try again in a moment.
push.unavailable: Push notifications are not available right now.
